name: Pitch Angle out of Bounds
hint: A pitch comparison outside -180° to 180° describes an impossible orientation, so tilt-dependent behaviour can become unreliable.
instruction: Constrain pitch readings and thresholds to the inclusive -180° through 180° range before comparing them.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
if <(@codeyB pitch angle° :: sensing) > (200)> then
say [Invalid pitch]
end
